novel_features.name: Kill-switch roster
novel_features.description: List every contact in the location tagged with `ai off` or `human handover` so you can audit who Riley should not be texting.

novel_features.name: Kill-switch check (typed exit)
novel_features.description: Return a typed exit code for a single contact: 0 clear, 2 ai-off, 3 human-handover. Designed to gate a send from a workflow.

novel_features.name: Activity window
novel_features.description: Recent activity across contacts, messages, opportunities, and appointments in one timeline. `--since 24h` or `--since 7d`.

novel_features.name: Tag analytics
novel_features.description: List every tag in the location with contact-count, last-used date, and a kill-switch flag.

novel_features.name: Daily KPI ticker
novel_features.description: One-line cross-entity aggregate: new contacts, SMS sent, appointments booked, opportunities moved, kill-switch trips — JSON-friendly for dashboard cron.

novel_features.name: Client recency
novel_features.description: For each contact (optionally filtered by tag), show last inbound and last outbound message timestamps; sort by oldest-last-touch.

novel_features.name: SMS send preflight
novel_features.description: Validate a planned SMS: contact exists, has E.164 phone, no `ai off` tag, optionally within business hours — returns typed exit code without sending.

novel_features.name: Inbox triage
novel_features.description: Conversations with unread inbound messages and no outbound reply in the window, kill-switch-aware (skips `ai off`).

novel_features.name: Stale opportunities
novel_features.description: List opportunities whose stage has not moved in N days, grouped by pipeline and stage.

novel_features.name: Workflow membership
novel_features.description: List the contacts currently enrolled in a workflow with a terse default.

novel_features.name: Pipeline funnel snapshot
novel_features.description: For one pipeline, count and total monetary value per stage in stage order.
